create_case_changer: create a CaseChanger to convert text to lower, upper, title, or random case
augment_text_with_case_augmenter: augment a list of texts by changing case at char, word, or all granularity
change_case_all: change the case of an entire text string using CaseAugmenter change_case_all method
change_case_chars: change the case of individual characters in text at a specified cadence frequency
change_case_words: change the case of individual words in text at a specified cadence frequency
